findings.where: "Where we're starting" section heading, desktop and phone (desktop: about 130 px type over two lines; phone: about 56 px against a hero wordmark of about 38 px)
findings.fault: The section heading is about twice the size of the hero's h1 wordmark, so in a squint it beats the hero and the coral CTA. A label that only introduces three small cards is the loudest thing on the page. On desktop it takes the whole lower half of the first screen and pushes the destination cards below the fold, so the first screen ends on a giant heading with nothing under it.
findings.who_objects: A backpacker landing on the homepage. They read the page's order from size, so the eye goes to a heading that says nothing about what MantaHostels is. The destination guides are one of the page's three jobs, but they are hidden behind a heading on desktop, and the hero's claim loses the top spot it needs.

findings.where: Hero copy column against the nav wordmark and the section below, desktop
findings.fault: The hero's text block starts at about x=424. The nav wordmark, the "Where we're starting" heading and the destination cards all share a left edge at about x=195. The hero is neither on that edge nor centred, so it floats right of the page's one strong vertical line. That breaks continuity between the nav, the hero and the content, and leaves the hero's left third empty.
findings.who_objects: A visitor scanning down the desktop page. The eye follows the left edge from the logo into the hero and finds nothing there, so the hero reads as a separate block that was dropped in rather than part of one layout. That works against the brand's "effortless" first feeling.

findings.where: Hero actions: the coral email button and the "Explore destinations" outline button, desktop
findings.fault: The two hero actions are stacked one above the other at different widths and in different shapes (a wide pill over a narrow square-cornered box), even though the 1440 px hero has plenty of room. They don't read as one group of choices (similarity and proximity are both weak). The outline button also hangs alone under the CTA's left end, which leaves a ragged right edge.
findings.who_objects: A first-time visitor deciding what to do. Two actions that don't look related read as two separate blocks instead of a main choice and a lesser one, so the hero's offer is slightly harder to take in at a glance.

findings.where: Hero wave band and the manta mark, desktop
findings.fault: Below the wave, a solid ink band about 120 px deep holds only the manta, pushed into the far right corner outside the content column (its right edge is past the 1246 px column edge). The band spends first-screen height on empty dark ground. The mark has no visual link to the hero copy it should sit with, so the figure reads as stranded rather than placed.
findings.who_objects: A desktop visitor. The first screen spends space on an empty band while the destination content is pushed below the fold, and the illustration, which is meant to carry the brand's personality, sits in a corner where few will look.
